hypothesis: A local neural transition trained on true Horner states can compose into non-trivial exact modular multiplication on prime identities excluded from training.

source.note: The reference checkpoint was trained before the outer research repository was initialized; the exact training script is retained with this run.

training.training_moduli: all integers from 8 through 63 except held-out primes 11, 23, 29, 37, and 61

notes: Public benchmark rows were not used for training or checkpoint selection.
Composite augmentation was selected after earlier prime-only pilots, so this is development evidence rather than a pristine confirmatory test.
The promoted modular implementation is behaviorally compatible; the immutable exact training script is retained to eliminate refactor ambiguity.
GroupNorm spans the fixed bit canvas, so the POC is not a strictly local width-independent cellular rule.
This run is not an official-interface or competition-scale submission.
